name: App
description: Root orchestrator for the renderer process. Instantiates CanvasArea and TopBar with full callback wiring. Manages workspace lifecycle: checks CLI workspace path, shows WelcomeModal if none, loads workspace state (restore or defaults), handles open workspace action. Sets up keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+N (new window), Ctrl+W (close active tab), Ctrl+Tab (cycle cards), Ctrl+P (file search), Ctrl+J (new terminal). Auto-saves workspace state to .cockpit/window.json on canvas state changes (JSON diff check against lastSaved). Restores user preferences (theme, grid style, zoom lock) on workspace load. Starts tutorial on first launch. Handles window control buttons (min/max/close). Delegates all plugin create/focus/reopen actions to CanvasArea through TopBar callbacks.

dependencies.usage: Menu bar with callbacks for all actions
Infinite canvas engine for card management

interface.constructor: () — Sets document.title='Cockpit IDE', loads persisted theme preference via loadThemePref(), registers document-level keydown listener for Ctrl+Shift+N/Ctrl+W/Ctrl+Tab/Ctrl+P/Ctrl+J shortcuts, instantiates CanvasArea on #canvas element, wires onStateChange→trySave, onTerminalsChanged/GitChanged/SpecsmapChanged→topBar setters, onLockToggle→zoom lock persistence, creates AboutModal/ThemeModal/Tutorial singletons, instantiates TopBar on #menu-bar with full callback map (grid change, theme toggle, open workspace, plugin create/focus/reopen, about, theme, tutorial, zoom), calls initWindowControls() and promptWorkspace()

methods.name: trySave
methods.description: Compares current canvas SaveState JSON against lastSaved; if different and wsPath is set, calls saveNow() and updates lastSaved

methods.name: saveNow
methods.description: Writes canvas.getSaveState() to .cockpit/window.json via IPC workspace:save

methods.name: loadThemePref
methods.description: Loads prefs via IPC prefs:load, restores theme via theme.setTheme(baseTheme, mode) or theme.setTheme(themeName) or legacy theme.setDark(isDark)

methods.name: promptWorkspace
methods.description: Checks CLI workspace path via IPC workspace:getPath; if present loads it, otherwise shows WelcomeModal; if modal returns null closes window

methods.name: openWorkspace
methods.description: Saves current state, opens native directory picker via IPC workspace:select, loads selected path

methods.name: loadWorkspace
methods.description: Sets wsPath, registers workspace via IPC workspace:setPath, loads window.json state; restores plugins (or creates defaults: Explorer + Terminal + auto arrange), restores viewport (zoom/pan/locked), restores preferences (gridStyle, zoomLocked), sets workspaceName, refreshes canvas, saves state, starts tutorial if showTutorial pref is not false

methods.name: startTutorial
methods.description: Calls tutorial.start() with onClose callback that saves showTutorial preference via IPC prefs:save

lifecycle.created_by: index.ts — renderer entry point instantiates new App()
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Lives for the entire renderer process lifetime (window close terminates process)
